title: fix(types): header-bar refusals and nine `body` docblocks name the parser tier's `unknown-prop` warning (objectui#10959)
body:
Fixes #10959
Clause-②: no — message, `.describe()` and docblock text only; every accept or refuse verdict stays byte-identical.

Implemented by the `os-dev` agent dispatched from the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_012UwY3ahMixEFkfTUxMVkYm` (`mode:subagent`). Base `1345e182d`, head `7089f691c`.

## What changed

Only the false clause changes. It changes on 18 sites of two kinds. The objectui#10928 wording names `not-a-container`, which would be false here, so it is not reused.

- **Refusal strings (zod face).** These are the 9 `HeaderBarSchema` refusals: `title`, `logo`, `nav`, `left`, `center`, `right`, `sticky`, `height` (objectui#10387) and `variant` (objectui#10286). Each message is also its `.describe()` text, through `retirementTombstone`.
  - Before: "no error, no warning, no element" (for `variant`, "no class").
  - After: "no render-time error or warning and no element; only the parser tier's `unknown-prop` warning noticed it". `variant` keeps "no class" in place of "no element".
- **`body?: never` docblocks (TS face, emitted `.d.ts`).** There are 9: `box`, `span`, `container`, `flex`, `stack`, `grid`, `scroll-area` in `layout.ts`, and `toggle`, `form` in `form.ts` (objectui#8284).
  - Before: "rendered an EMPTY element with no error and no warning".
  - After: "rendered an EMPTY element with no render-time error or warning; only the parser tier's `unknown-prop` warning noticed it".
- **New pin:** `packages/types/src/__tests__/unknown-prop-parser-tier-clause-10959.test.ts`.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/10959-unknown-prop-parser-tier-clause.md`, `@object-ui/types: patch`.

## The parser tier, measured before the clause was written

**Instrument.** A one-shot probe, deleted and not committed. It sat under `packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/` and built the manifest from the live registry the way `container-declaration-ratchet.test.tsx` does: every KNOWN key, through `manifestFromConfigs`. It imported `components`, `fields` and 18 of the 19 `plugin-*` packages (all but `plugin-designer`). Then it ran `validateTree` once per leg. It also rendered each leg through the real `SchemaRenderer`, spying on `console.warn` and `console.error`, and compared the HTML with the leg's control.

**Population and result.**

| population | legs | what each leg adds |
|---|---|---|
| `header-bar` and `ui:header-bar` (inputs `crumbs`, `search`, `actions`, `rightContent`) × the 9 keys × every value the objectui#10387 / objectui#10286 pins use (strings, a node, a node list, booleans, numbers, the 4 `variant` spellings) | 44 | exactly one `unknown-prop` warning; HTML byte-identical to the control; 0 console warnings, 0 console errors |
| the bare and `ui:` key of the 9 `body` nodes (18 keys, each declares the `children` input and no `body` input) × `body` as a list, a single node and a scalar | 54 | exactly one `unknown-prop` warning (the `checkRetiredBodyDialect` sentence that names `children`); HTML byte-identical to the control; 0 console warnings, 0 console errors |

**Answer to the mechanism assumption about value shape.** Scalar and list give the same code on these nine. `checkRetiredBodyDialect` answers `not-a-container` only where the registration declares no `children` input, and all 18 keys declare it. So the list, the single node and the scalar all draw `unknown-prop`.

**Controls.**
- `accordion` and `input` declare no `children` input. There a `body` list draws `not-a-container`, a scalar `body` draws `unknown-prop`, and an invented key draws `unknown-prop`. So the probe can tell the two codes apart.
- The `header-bar` control renders a `header` element with 0 console warnings and 0 console errors.
  - A first run rendered `header-bar` bare. It logged the `useSidebar` provider error on the control and on every leg alike, so its render comparison proved nothing.
  - That run was discarded. The render leg was re-run inside `sidebar-provider`, the context the containment ratchet uses for the sidebar parts.

**The same answer before each retirement (source reading, not executed).** The strings and docblocks are in the past tense, so the pre-retirement tree was read too.
- At `236a71fe3`, the parent of the objectui#8284 tombstone commit `b1777aef3`:
  - `validate.ts` had no `body` in its base-prop set and no `checkRetiredBodyDialect`, so an undeclared key drew `unknown-prop`;
  - none of the nine registrations declared a `body` input (zero quoted `'body'` / `"body"` in the nine files).
- `header-bar.tsx` did not change between `6214db63f` (2026-09-11) and the two retirements (objectui#10286 `a05c35063`, objectui#10387 `9b281519f`). Read at `a05c35063`, its registration declared the same four inputs it declares today.

## Census, base `1345e182d` vs head `7089f691c`

These counts are over joined text: JSDoc continuations and `'…' + '…'` joins are removed, and an escaped quote is unescaped.

| file | old string clause | new string clause | old docblock clause | new docblock clause | control: `header-bar` refusal head | control: objectui#8284 docblock sentence | control: objectui#10928 clause | absent token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `zod/navigation.zod.ts` | 9 → 0 | 0 → 9 | 0 → 0 | 0 → 0 | 9 / 9 | 0 / 0 | 10 / 10 | 0 / 0 |
| `layout.ts` | 0 → 0 | 0 → 0 | 7 → 0 | 0 → 7 | 0 / 0 | 7 / 7 | 12 / 12 | 0 / 0 |
| `form.ts` | 0 → 0 | 0 → 0 | 2 → 0 | 0 → 2 | 0 / 0 | 2 / 2 | 28 / 28 | 0 / 0 |

- Over all 67 non-test `.ts` files of `packages/types/src` at base (enumerated from the ref with `git ls-tree`, not from the working tree), the old string clause and the old docblock clause occur only in these three files.
- **Emitted `dist`**, after `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build` at head:
  - old string clause 0, new 18 (`zod/navigation.zod.js` and `zod/index.zod.js`, 9 each);
  - old docblock clause 0, new 9 (`layout.d.ts` 7, `form.d.ts` 2).
- **On the built dist**, `safeValidateSchema` on `header-bar` answers as follows:
  - with `title`: `invalid_type` at path `title`, and the message carries the new clause and not the old one;
  - with `variant`: the same;
  - control (only `crumbs`): success.

## Every other byte, and only string and comment lines

- Take each head file and substitute the old clause back for the new one: 9, 7 and 2 substitutions. Each result is byte-identical to the base file.
- `git diff -U0` over the three files: every changed line is a `+ '…'` string-literal line (zod) or a ` * ` JSDoc continuation line. No other line changed.
- On the docblock face, the replaced text wraps onto three lines where the old text used two. The joined text differs only in the clause.
- The objectui#10387 and objectui#10286 pins (codes, paths, message heads) pass unchanged.

## Reverse verification (ablation), after the fix was committed

**Instrument.** objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, in WRAP mode, run from this worktree. The anchor must hit exactly once, and the on-disk blob must move. The tool proves each restore (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), and the driver re-proves it independently. The types tests import `../zod/*` source and read `layout.ts` / `form.ts` from disk, so no build sits between a mutation and the run.

| leg: the old clause put back into | blob mutated to | red / 7 | red tests |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant`'s string | `59f587b96` | 2 | the `variant` arm, the `header-bar` population |
| `title`'s string | `c80665c61` | 2 | the `title` arm, the `header-bar` population |
| `BoxSchema.body` docblock | `2383fde4f` | 2 | the `BoxSchema` docblock, the docblock population |
| `GridSchema.body` docblock (not named by the pin) | `a3ac19fa8` | 1 | the docblock population |
| `ToggleSchema.body` docblock in `form.ts` (not named by the pin) | `5e4c2ac67` | 1 | the docblock population |

Each leg restored to its HEAD blob (`ad46ba82c`, `a90b246c7`, `daad6d395`) with an empty `git diff HEAD`. After the run, `git status --porcelain` was empty.

## The pin

It follows the house style of PR objectui#10956's pin. `@object-ui/types` declares no workspace dependency, so the pin holds the prose, not the parser.

- **Zod face.**
  - For `title` and `variant`, one per clause form, it asserts code `invalid_type` and path `[key]` first, then the clause substring. It also asserts that neither the old clause nor `not-a-container` appears.
  - Then the population: every `HeaderBarSchema` member whose refusal is an objectui#10387 / objectui#10286 retirement carries the clause. Non-vacuity is by name (`title`, `variant`).
- **TS face.** Precedent for pinning docblock text: `layout-default-jsdoc-7361.test.ts`.
  - The `body` docblocks of `BoxSchema` and `FormSchema` carry the clause.
  - Then the population: every docblock in `layout.ts` and `form.ts` that carries objectui#8284's sentence carries it too. Non-vacuity: both files are reached.
  - The repo root comes from the pin's own `import.meta.url`, never the cwd (`check:test-path-roots` passes).
- **Where the parser half lives.** The `body` half is pinned in `packages/sdui-parser`, by "the retired `body` spelling follows the SAME predicate" (`containment-declared-slot-9910.test.ts`) and "a `body` child list under a CONTAINER draws `unknown-prop` naming `children`" (`body-dialect-6771.test.ts`). The `header-bar` half is `validateTree`'s generic undeclared-key branch, and no pin there names `header-bar`. See Open question.

## Dispatch assumptions, checked

1. **Holds.** Counts are 9 / 7 / 2 on base `1345e182d`, a descendant of `328abeb55` (`merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 0), with controls. See Census.
2. **Holds, and made more exact.** Every key and every value shape draws `unknown-prop`. None draws `not-a-container`, because all 18 `body` keys declare `children`. See the table.
3. **Does not hold.** The objectui#10928 pin (`content-channel-parser-tier-clause-10928.test.ts`) does not name the 8 `HeaderBarSchema` sites. Its population walk reads only the family-D `body` / `children` members (`reads NEITHER content channel:`). It passes unchanged at head, so it is not edited. The 8 sites appear only in PR objectui#10956's description.
4. **Not re-scanned by this dev.** The PM files-API scan is taken as given. This diff touches none of PR objectui#10972's or PR objectui#10977's files.

## Gates, head `7089f691c`

All ran after the last commit. Exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build` → 0. It includes `check-dist-completeness`: 134 emitted files verified.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` → 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the new pin.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types lint` → 0, with 0 errors. The new file has no warnings; the package has 295 existing `no-explicit-any` warnings.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` → 0: 269 files and 5962 tests passed.
- The tests outside `types` that read the edited files, plus the parser pins named above → 0: 9 files, 276 tests.
  - `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-component-types.test.ts`, `check-spec-symbol-derivation.test.ts`, `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts` and `check-pending-changeset-literals.test.ts`;
  - the three `header-bar` component tests;
  - `body-dialect-6771` and `containment-declared-slot-9910`.
- `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed` and `check-changeset-overwrite` → 0.
- `check-changeset-claims` → 0. It is report-only. It lists 17 pending changesets that name an edited file. None of them quotes either clause this PR changes. The only pending changeset carrying the old string clause is objectui#10928's, about the family-D refusals, and that is still true.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots` and `check:phantom-deps` → 0.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 5 paths → NOT GOVERNED.
- Declared to CI: repo-wide `pnpm lint`, full `pnpm test` and the other workflow gates.

## Acceptance notes

Same family, not changed here, and left for the seat to route. Each carries the old silence claim, and the parser tier answers it (live registry, same probe):

- `zod/form.zod.ts`, the `FormSchema.mode` refusal (objectui#10286): "every spelling rendered the same form — no error, no warning". `form` with `mode` draws `unknown-prop`.
- `data-display.ts`, the `TimelineSchema.events` docblock (objectui#6170): "drew an EMPTY rail, with no error and no warning". A bare `timeline` with `events` draws `unknown-prop`. The live registry resolves that key to `plugin-timeline`'s `view` registration, so this reading is about that registration. This file is PR objectui#10972's surface.
- `base.ts`, the `bind` docblock: "`data-table` … renders its header over an empty body, with no error and no warning". `data-table` with `bind` draws `unknown-prop`.
- `zod/objectql.zod.ts`, the `exportOptions` describe text (objectui#7762): "no error, no warning, no console line". `object-grid` with an `exportOptions` array draws `type-mismatch`.

Boundary: the names `grid` and `form` also exist as `view:grid`, `view:form` and `field:grid`. Those are different registrations and node types, which the `GridSchema` / `FormSchema` docblocks do not describe. None of them declares `children`, so a `body` list there draws `not-a-container`.

## Open question

Should a live-registry pin in `packages/components` also hold the parser behaviour the `header-bar` clause describes? No such pin exists today. This PR does not add one: it is outside the claimed file surface, and the same question is open from PR objectui#10956.
